description: Storybloq's empirical benchmark: MCP alone is 34x faster but misses qualitative context; file reading gets the nuance but is slow. Optimal is both: pre-computed structured summaries via MCP (fast path) + accumulated qualitative files (PERSONA.md, PLAYBOOK.md). Currently zug_get_context only does the slow qualitative path. Split into: (1) a fast structured summary endpoint with key stats + active patterns, (2) full qualitative load on demand. Informs T-002 and T-005.
title: Session priming hybrid — structured MCP summaries + qualitative files
